svg.title: Arsenal — tech stack constellations
svg.desc: Python at the centre, linked to four constellations: generative AI, machine learning, data and cloud, and engineering. LangChain, RAG, FAISS, ChromaDB, Ollama, Whisper.cpp, Llama 3.2, Qwen-2.5, Hugging Face, PyTorch, TensorFlow, scikit-learn, XGBoost, LightGBM, MLflow, PySpark, Databricks, Azure Data Factory, PostgreSQL, Azure, Linux, Flask, Docker, GitHub Actions, pytest, React, Streamlit, Git, Bash, C++, JavaScript.
